title: a merge leaves nothing open and no decision on the duplicate
line: the 1920 household's Anna R merged into her sister Alicia M, the harness's own merge of two children of one family: the question both hold, a missing spouse, closes on Anna as answered by the merge and her others move; the census's Alicia M, which the harness's own decision had put to Anna as well, folds onto Alicia's link, the rule's decision standing and nothing left on Anna; and Anna's name as the census writes it moves to Alicia as an alias

the owner accepts Anna on the census, her name as it writes it an alias
the harness's own decision putting the census's Alicia M to Anna as well, as one child entered twice would carry the same entry
